about: Model names shared by the Logic & Math, Reading and backgammon sites (Ümit #4445, jevgammon #4480): per model identity (the key; model_key the join key) the maker's official name (name) with the evidence it was read from, whether its weights are released (open, open_note), the model it is built on (base_model) and its snapshot or version tag (snapshot). A key with name equal to the key needs no renaming. Site-specific setup labels map to these keys in each site's code. source_status: 'maker' (a display title the maker wrote, quoted in evidence), 'inferred' (by analogy, see source_note), 'openrouter-only' (known only from OpenRouter's page), 'unverified' (no maker-written title found; see source_note). Not every name is maker-proven.
